# Remove-ZbxHttpTest

## SYNOPSIS

Deletes web scenarios.

## SYNTAX

```
Remove-ZbxHttpTest [-Id] <ulong[]> [-Force] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Remove-ZbxHttpTest cmdlet deletes the web scenarios with the ids in -Id, or piped from Get-ZbxHttpTest, with httptest.delete, in one call when the pipeline ends; the items the scenarios made go with them. It asks for confirmation for each scenario unless -Confirm:$false or -Force is given, and -WhatIf lists what would be deleted. It writes nothing.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Delete a scenario by name

```powershell
Get-ZbxHttpTest -Name 'Checkout' | Remove-ZbxHttpTest -Confirm:$false
```

-Id takes ids, not names: Get-ZbxHttpTest finds the scenario and the pipeline passes its HttpTestId.

### Example 2: Preview deleting every scenario of a host

```powershell
Get-ZbxHttpTest -Host 'web-01' | Remove-ZbxHttpTest -WhatIf
```

-WhatIf names each scenario the command would delete, and deletes nothing.
